diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~17% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.329), which favours a weighted combination.
